subproblem.title: Upper ball-mass bound at a weighted approximate tangent point
subproblem.statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ and H^n := μHE[n] on ℝ^N = Euclidean N. Let M ⊆ ℝ^N be H^n-null-measurable, θ : ℝ^N → ℝ with θ ≥ 0 on M, x ∈ M, P a linear subspace of ℝ^N, and r₀ > 0 with θ H^n-integrable on M ∩ B̄_{r₀}(x). Assume M has weighted approximate tangent space P at x with respect to θ (Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x P). Let ν := (H^n⌞M).withDensity(ofReal ∘ θ) and ω̂_n := unitBallVolume n. Then for every c ∈ [0, ∞] with ofReal(θ(x)) · ω̂_n < c, eventually as t → 0⁺: ν(B̄_t(x)) ≤ c · ofReal(t)^n.
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclidean N)) (θ : Euclidean N → ℝ) (x : Euclidean N) (P : Submodule ℝ (Euclidean N)) (r₀ : ℝ), NullMeasurableSet M (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) → (∀ y ∈ M, 0 ≤ θ y) → x ∈ M → 0 < r₀ → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ closedBall x r₀) μHE[n] → Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x P → ∀ c : ℝ≥0∞, ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) * unitBallVolume n < c → ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), (((μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)).restrict M).withDensity fun y ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (θ y)) (closedBall x t) ≤ c * ENNReal.ofReal t ^ n
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: steps 2–5 of the selected proof (Simon Ch. 3, Remark 1.8(2)), upper half: the outer cutoff f₂ (1_{B̄_1} ≤ f₂ ≤ 1_{B̄_{1/κ}}) and the limsup bound, written for a single c. Notation: H^n := μHE[n]; B̄_s(z) := closedBall z s; ν := (H^n⌞M).withDensity(ofReal ∘ θ); ω̂ := unitBallVolume n; ω := ω̂.toReal ≥ 0; η_t := Chapter03.blowUpMap x t; I_f(t) := ∫_{η_t(M)} f(y) θ(x + t•y) dH^n(y). HWATS gives finrank P = n and I_f(t) → θ(x)∫_P f dH^n along 𝓝[>] 0 for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^N, ℝ).

0. ω̂ < ∞, since it is the volume of a bounded ball in a proper space (measure_ball_lt_top), so ω̂ = ofReal ω. Also θ(x) ≥ 0 because x ∈ M.

1. Case c = ∞. For t > 0, ofReal(t) > 0, so ofReal(t)^n ≠ 0 and ∞ · ofReal(t)^n = ∞ (ENNReal.top_mul). Then ν(B̄_t(x)) ≤ ∞ holds for every t ∈ (0, ∞), a set in 𝓝[>] 0 (self_mem_nhdsWithin). Assume from now on c ≠ ∞.

2. Put c' := c.toReal, so c = ofReal(c'). Since θ(x) ≥ 0, ofReal(θ(x)) · ω̂ = ofReal(θ(x)·ω) (ENNReal.ofReal_mul, ENNReal.ofReal_toReal). So ofReal(θ(x)·ω) < ofReal(c'), which gives θ(x)·ω < c' (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff').

3. Choice of κ. κ ↦ θ(x)·ω·(κ⁻¹)^n is continuous at κ = 1, because inversion is continuous at 1 ≠ 0. Its value there is θ(x)·ω < c', so eventually along 𝓝[<] 1 it stays below c' (Filter.Tendsto.eventually_lt_const). Intersect with Ioo 0 1 ∈ 𝓝[<] 1 (Ioo_mem_nhdsLT). The filter 𝓝[<] 1 on ℝ is non-trivial, so the intersection is nonempty (Filter.Eventually.and, Filter.Eventually.exists). Pick κ in it: 0 < κ < 1 and θ(x)·ω·(κ⁻¹)^n < c'. Then κ⁻¹ > 1 (one_lt_inv₀).

4. Outer cutoff. Apply the sibling plane_cutoff (Submission.intcpt_id_tpd_plane_cutoff) to P with (a, R) := (1, κ⁻¹), using finrank P = n and 0 < 1 < κ⁻¹. It gives f ∈ C_c(ℝ^N, ℝ) with: 0 ≤ f ≤ 1; f(y) = 1 for ‖y‖ ≤ 1; f(y) = 0 for ‖y‖ > κ⁻¹; and ∫_P f dH^n ≤ ω·(κ⁻¹)^n.

5. Limit. By HWATS applied to f, I_f(t) → θ(x)·∫_P f dH^n. Moreover
 θ(x)·∫_P f dH^n ≤ θ(x)·(ω·(κ⁻¹)^n) = θ(x)·ω·(κ⁻¹)^n < c' (θ(x) ≥ 0, step 4).
 Hence ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] 0, I_f(t) < c' (Filter.Tendsto.eventually_lt_const).

6. Sandwich. Since κ·r₀ > 0, ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] 0, t ∈ (0, κ·r₀] (Ioc_mem_nhdsGT). For such t, t·κ⁻¹ = t/κ ≤ r₀ (div_le_iff₀). Fix t in both eventual sets. Apply the sibling ball_sandwich (Submission.intcpt_id_tpd_ball_sandwich) with (f, r₀, a, R, r) := (f, r₀, 1, κ⁻¹, t). Its left inequality gives ν(B̄_{t·1}(x)) ≤ ofReal(t^n · I_f(t)), i.e. ν(B̄_t(x)) ≤ ofReal(t^n · I_f(t)).

7. Conclusion. For such t:
 ν(B̄_t(x)) ≤ ofReal(t^n · I_f(t))
 ≤ ofReal(t^n · c') (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal, since t^n ≥ 0 and I_f(t) < c')
 = ofReal(c') · ofReal(t)^n (mul_comm, ENNReal.ofReal_mul with c' ≥ 0, ENNReal.ofReal_pow with t ≥ 0)
 = c · ofReal(t)^n.
 This holds on a set belonging to 𝓝[>] 0. Together with step 1 this proves the claim. ∎
proof_key_steps: c = ∞ is trivial for t > 0; otherwise c = ofReal(c') with θ(x)ω < c' (θ(x) ≥ 0 as x ∈ M).
Choose κ ∈ (0,1) with θ(x)ω(κ⁻¹)^n < c' (continuity of κ⁻¹ at 1).
Sibling plane_cutoff with (a,R) = (1,κ⁻¹): f ∈ C_c, 1_{B̄_1} ≤ f ≤ 1_{B̄_{1/κ}}, ∫_P f ≤ ω(κ⁻¹)^n.
HWATS: I_f(t) → θ(x)∫_P f < c', so eventually I_f(t) < c'.
For 0 < t ≤ κr₀ (so tκ⁻¹ ≤ r₀), sibling ball_sandwich gives ν(B̄_t(x)) ≤ ofReal(t^n I_f(t)) ≤ ofReal(t^n c') = c·ofReal(t)^n.

audit.reason: Membership x ∈ M correctly supplies θ(x) ≥ 0. The proof handles c = ∞ separately; otherwise the outer cutoff, tangent convergence and left sandwich inequality give the exact eventual upper bound, including zero weight and dimension zero.
